title: Investigation of long non-coding RNAs in extracellular vesicles from low-volume blood serum specimens of colorectal cancer patients
description: The study aimed to investigate the patterns of long non-coding RNAs in small extracellular vesicles collected from low-volume blood serum specimens of colorectal cancer patients, focusing on their potential as diagnostic biomarkers.
